instruction: Build a blog-style article page about browser-grounded web agents. The page must include a main article column, a sidebar of related posts, and a button for saving or sharing the article. Add data-testid="main-article" to the article column, data-testid="related-posts" to the related posts sidebar, and data-testid="share-article-button" to the save/share button.

metadata.expected_behavior: The generated page should include a main article column, related posts sidebar, and save/share button.
